page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.d1ne.6xlarge is a big data-focused virtual server hosted on the KVM hypervisor. It is driven by an Intel Xeon E5-2682v4 processor running at 2.5 GHz across 12 physical cores, yielding 24 dedicated vCPUs via hyper-threading. System memory totals 96.0 GB, maintaining a balanced 1:4 vCPU-to-memory ratio at 4.0 GB per core. The instance provides a baseline network bandwidth of 16 Gbps and does not include GPU acceleration hardware.

A primary hardware characteristic is the bundled 70,866 GB of local HDD storage, providing substantial raw capacity directly attached to the host. In benchmark evaluations, the server achieves average multi-threaded computational output, registering a PassMark CPU score of 18,256.63 and a multi-core Geekbench score of 7,235.0. Conversely, single-core processing metrics are weak, with single-core Geekbench testing at 955.0 and single-threaded gzip compression at 18.97 GB/sec. Uncached large-block memory read bandwidth reaches 58.61 GB/sec.

The dense mechanical storage design delivers favorable cost efficiency for storage-heavy workloads compared to solid-state storage classes, though it introduces a latency tradeoff inherent to rotating disk media. Consequently, ecs.d1ne.6xlarge is optimized for sequential data pipelines, Apache Hadoop clusters, distributed data repositories, log aggregation systems, and batch processing where sheer storage volume is prioritized over low-latency random input and output operations.
